profile.summary: SEIU 1021 is a labor union representing service-sector workers across Northern California, including public employees, healthcare workers, community college staff and school district classified staff. It negotiates contracts, advocates for its members and organizes workers. It is a local of the Service Employees International Union.

review.notes: The agenda item is an MOU between OUSD and SEIU Local 1021, and seiu1021.org has a dedicated OUSD classified-staff page covering early childhood workers. The contact page confirms the 2201 Broadway Ste 725 address and (510) 350-9811, and the summary is neutral and consistent with the sources.
